title: CodegenTool tests should discover the Undertow root
body: The baseline command `dotnet test /home/liory/projects/Yeroket-Fantasy/.claude-worktrees/rva1/Packages/com.yeroket.utility.kernel-framework/CodegenTool~/Tests/CodegenTool.Tests.csproj -c Release --no-build -nodeReuse:false` had 9 failures because tests assumed an Undertow checkout at a stale hard-coded path. Prefixing the same queued test with `UNDERTOW_ROOT=/home/liory/projects/undertow` made it pass (2077 passed, 2 skipped). Make the test runner or fixture discovery resolve this dependency deterministically so workers do not need a machine-specific environment override.

title: Standard VIXEN build should regenerate merged SDI before drift checks
body: The untouched VIXEN build passed, but `ctest --test-dir build/wsl --output-on-failure --parallel 3` failed `sdi_merged_drift_check`: five committed merged headers had stale LightingConfigSSBO size and layout hash. Running the documented `build/wsl/bin/sdi_tool merge-variants shaders/sdi-variants.json` regenerated only those five outputs; the subsequent `--check` and full CTest run passed this gate. Make the standard queued build or an earlier codegen gate regenerate/check merged SDI outputs before the full test suite.

title: Kernel solution build exits successfully without discovering projects
body: The queued command dotnet build Yeroket-Fantasy.sln -c Release -nodeReuse:false returned exit 0 with 'Unable to find a project to restore!' and compiled nothing. Kernel validation required explicit builds of SourceGenerator~/Tests/SDFNodeGenerator.Tests.csproj and CodegenTool~/Tests/CodegenTool.Tests.csproj. Keep a solution or documented queued validation entry point that includes the kernel test projects and treats an empty project selection as failure.

title: Capture script must resolve output directory before changing working directory
body: The queued capture command passed a relative capture root to tools/run-vixen-windowed-captures.sh. The script later changes into each runtime directory, so both apps rendered successfully but stbi_write_png failed to create every capture beneath build/wsl/binaries/.tmp. Passing an absolute capture root fixes it. Resolve capture_root to an absolute path at script startup or document that requirement in the usage contract.

title: Untouched wave baseline configure re-provisions Vulkan and X11 dependencies
body: The opcode-94 check against the untouched wave tip required a source snapshot under build/wave-baseline/VIXEN and a fresh queued CMake configure using -DYEROKET_ROOT=/home/liory/projects/Yeroket-Fantasy -DVIXEN_YEROKET_KERNEL_SHA_OVERRIDE=8d68e9839ac3af02b937b2b419c27f829e90cccc -DUNDERTOW_ROOT=/home/liory/projects/undertow and an isolated FetchContent path. Configure succeeded but provisioned a source-local Vulkan SDK (~320 MB), X11 development files, and missing FetchContent projects before CTest could run. A documented queued wave-baseline profile with shared immutable provisioning payloads and per-worktree build state would remove this manual setup.
